# relay-message-payload

Behavior contract:
message_payload(line) accepts a single log line starting exactly with 'message=' and returns everything after that one prefix unchanged. Empty payloads are allowed; further occurrences of 'message=' are ordinary payload text. If the prefix is absent or not at the start, raise ValueError. Preserve spaces and equals signs.

Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.
Use only the Python 3.12 standard library. Keep the interface and leave tests/ unchanged.
